knowledge: A hero's appearance and affiliations come from the dimension lookups: eye colour, hair colour and skin colour are the colour names looked up through the respective colour id ("no eye colour" is the no-colour value); race (e.g. human), gender (Male/Female), publisher (Marvel Comics / DC Comics) and alignment (Good/Bad/Neutral) are read the same way. A hero is named by the superhero name, and a missing real name means the full-name field is empty.

A hero's abilities are recorded as named attributes with values (e.g. Speed, Strength, Durability, Intelligence): "the fastest/strongest/bravest" is the maximum value of that attribute, "the slowest/dumbest" the minimum, and "durability below 50" a filter on that attribute's value. Superpowers are the named powers a hero has.
Measurements read as usual: heights and weights are numeric, "the tallest" is the maximum height, "from 170 to 190" a height range, and averages and differences are taken over the heroes in scope.

Percentages and ratios count the same entities on both sides: the share of heroes with a property is the count of those heroes divided by the count of heroes in scope, times 100 (filters on gender, publisher or colour scope both counts); a ratio divides one hero count by another.
